description: The tree snapshot engine of Proof-of-Done (lib/proof/tree-snapshot.mjs, lib/proof/git-plumbing.mjs, P4 pod-15): the pinned Git environment and flags, no alternate store, the choice of raw-v1, the exclusions and their Git form, the object ids, the limits, the stat cache and the ignore-rule follow-up of a reused index, judged by tests/verify-proof-tree.mjs.

mutations.name: PT-autocrlf-on
mutations.what: core.autocrlf=true on the pinned command line

mutations.name: PT-system-config-read
mutations.what: the system configuration is read (Git for Windows sets core.autocrlf=true there)

mutations.name: PT-global-config-read
mutations.what: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL is not pointed at the empty file, so ~/.gitconfig applies

mutations.name: PT-inherited-git-env
mutations.what: the GIT_* variables of the caller are kept

mutations.name: PT-longpaths-off
mutations.what: core.longpaths=false

mutations.name: PT-sparse-on
mutations.what: the sparse-checkout setting of the repository is not switched off
mutations.equivalent: no id changes: the temporary index has no skip-worktree bits and git add still takes a file written outside the cone (the sparse fixture writes one); the setting only costs time, so the warm budget kills it in some runs (measured: 403 ms > 300 ms) and lets it pass in others

mutations.name: PT-blob-header
mutations.what: the blob header counts one byte too many

mutations.name: PT-tree-order
mutations.what: a folder sorts by its bare name, not as name + "/"

patches.old: return entry.mode === MODE.tree ? Buffer.concat([entry.name, Buffer.from('/')]) : entry.name;

mutations.name: PT-gitlink-packed-refs
mutations.what: a branch found only in packed-refs is not resolved

mutations.name: PT-alternates
mutations.what: the repository's objects are given to Git as an alternate store (Git then freshens them)

patches.old: const env = pinnedEnv(this.env, { gitDir: plan.gitDir, workTree: this.root, indexFile, objectDirectory, emptyConfig });
patches.new: const env = pinnedEnv(this.env, { gitDir: plan.gitDir, workTree: this.root, indexFile, objectDirectory, emptyConfig, alternates: [path.join(plan.commonDir, 'objects')] });

mutations.name: PT-listing-excludes
mutations.what: the listing applies the exclude file, so protected files are not counted

mutations.name: PT-add-without-exclude-file
mutations.what: add -A gets the empty file instead of the exclude lines
mutations.equivalent: the exclude file only keeps Git from hashing a secret: the tree is filtered with exclusionOf() and a leaked entry's blob is deleted from the private store, so ids, counts and the store end the same (the file is defence in depth, kept because a .gitignore can re-include a secret anyway)

mutations.name: PT-attributes-file-unset
mutations.what: core.attributesFile is not named, so ~/.config/git/attributes applies

mutations.name: PT-fsmonitor-kept
mutations.what: a core.fsmonitor program does not select raw-v1

mutations.name: PT-filters-kept
mutations.what: a repository filter that git-trust allows (Git LFS) does not select raw-v1

mutations.name: PT-refusal-ignored
mutations.what: a refused repository configuration still lets Git run

mutations.name: PT-racy-window-zero
mutations.what: no racy window: an entry cached in the same tick is trusted

mutations.name: PT-cache-without-ctime
mutations.what: the raw-v1 cache ignores the change time

mutations.name: PT-full-uses-cache
mutations.what: a full snapshot trusts the stat cache

mutations.name: PT-no-index-info
mutations.what: the fresh index is not seeded with the raw rows

mutations.name: PT-no-refresh
mutations.what: the seeded index is not refreshed

mutations.name: PT-differing-zero
mutations.what: the entries that still need an update are not counted

mutations.name: PT-new-blobs-boundary
mutations.what: exactly maxNewBlobs already selects raw-v1

mutations.name: PT-max-files-boundary
mutations.what: exactly maxFiles is unbounded

mutations.name: PT-max-bytes-boundary
mutations.what: exactly maxBytes is unbounded

mutations.name: PT-ignore-change-missed
mutations.what: a reused index keeps entries that a changed ignore rule now excludes

mutations.name: PT-info-exclude-missed
mutations.what: a change to .git/info/exclude does not change the fingerprint

mutations.name: PT-leak-kept
mutations.what: a protected file that a .gitignore re-included stays in the tree

mutations.name: PT-leak-blob-kept
mutations.what: the blob of a re-included protected file stays in the private store

mutations.name: PT-gitlink-not-excluded
mutations.what: an empty nested repository is given to git add (which then fails)

mutations.name: PT-index-never-ready
mutations.what: the index of a full snapshot is not kept for cached snapshots

mutations.name: PT-runs-kept
mutations.what: .chatmcp/runs is not excluded

mutations.name: PT-protected-kept
mutations.what: protected files are not excluded

mutations.name: PT-case-folding-off
mutations.what: the exclude globs keep their lower case (core.ignorecase decides)

mutations.name: PT-folders-not-reincluded
mutations.what: a folder named like a secret file is hidden by the name glob

mutations.name: PT-complement-inverted
mutations.what: the .env complement globs exclude the example names instead of the others

mutations.name: PT-tfstate-digits-short
mutations.what: three digits are written out for .tfstate.<digits>, the prefix takes over at four

mutations.name: PT-env-dist-protected
mutations.what: .env.dist is no longer an example name

mutations.name: PT-executable-bit-lost
mutations.what: raw-v1 never records an executable bit

mutations.name: PT-symlink-lost
mutations.what: raw-v1 does not record symlinks

patches.old: if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) return { relative, absolute, stat, mode: MODE.symlink };
patches.new: if (false) return { relative, absolute, stat, mode: MODE.symlink };

mutations.name: PT-walk-enters-git
mutations.what: the walk without Git goes into .git

mutations.name: PT-git-not-probed
mutations.what: a Git path that cannot start is taken as usable

mutations.name: PT-engine-not-forced
mutations.what: engine: 'raw-v1' is ignored

mutations.name: PT-tracked-not-listed
mutations.what: the listing leaves out tracked files that an ignore rule matches (finding F1)

patches.old: for (const file of (await this.trackedPaths(plan, signal)).paths) if

mutations.name: PT-tracked-not-readded
mutations.what: a cached snapshot does not add tracked files the temporary index lacks

mutations.name: PT-tracked-dropped
mutations.what: a changed ignore rule drops tracked files from a reused index too

mutations.name: PT-tracked-key-ignored
mutations.what: a change of the repository's index does not make a reused index re-check ignored entries

mutations.name: PT-tracked-memo-stale
mutations.what: the tracked paths are read once and never again

mutations.name: PT-no-raw-tree
mutations.what: a full snapshot does not report rawTree
